# Structural Foundation and Framing Plan

**Document:** PSD-STR-101
**Revision:** 0
**Status:** Issued for proposal

Foundations are shown using a preliminary allowable bearing value of 150 kPa
and a normal groundwater assumption. Confirm final values against PSD-GEO-001
before construction. The north service-yard footing remains subject to the
additional test-pit verification identified in the geotechnical summary.

At grid 4, the transfer beam support is detailed with a steel knife plate. At
grid 7, the comparable support uses a cast-in seat because the adjacent wall
and access condition differ. At grid 9, the connection note omits the support
reaction and refers to “coordinate with delegated support design.”

The framing is otherwise coordinated for the proposal stage; the unresolved
geotechnical and delegated-support conditions are not represented as final
construction release.
